item: Row J: the boot says how many fields a catalogue stopped shipping, and counts a held feed once per step instead of summing it twice
refs: R100; R153; branch claude/v0-5-plan-j8zvre (PR number at push)
summary: From the independent read of the J3 head (L3): the corrections log line was gated on applied-or-conflicts, so a field the catalogue stopped shipping (kept by R100, counted as dropped) was invisible; it now also fires on dropped and names the dropped and advanced counts. The boot line for feeds left unqualified because another feed of their outlet is disqualified summed the stamp's and the overlay's counts, which count the same feed once each, so one held feed logged as 2; it now lives in qualification_overlay.log_outlet_holds and names the two figures separately. Tests pin both lines (red without) and that main.py goes through the helper.
